title: I got tired of fake ad games so I made one on my own lol
author: WorkingAd5430
selftext:
Hi guys, just wanted to get some feedback on a game we vibe coded, kept seeing fake ad games where it’s fun but the actual game is not what you played, so I wanted to just see if I could make one actual one on my own. Hope to get you guys’ feedback and suggestions, please feel free to let me know how to improve it! Thanks!

It plays in your browser, nothing to install: https://legpain.itch.io/hold-the-bridge-demo

Tap "Run game", then the fullscreen button in the corner. It's about 80 MB the first time, so Wi-Fi is best. If it's slow, pick "Low" graphics on the start screen.

Looking forward to honest honest feedback! Hold this bridge!

comments.author: NSTStudios
comments.body: I played it. It is fun, quite hectic. I am not actually sure what the guy at the side is doing? He is swinging at the bridge or something?
